Synthetic article fixture for reader tests

This document is a synthetic fixture written for the Tap reader package tests. Its only purpose is to be long and structured enough that go-readability classifies it as the article body rather than as boilerplate.

Why this fixture exists

Readability heuristics need real prose with multiple paragraphs, a heading or two, and some surrounding navigation chrome to decide which subtree is the article. Synthetic placeholder text here, repeated and varied across paragraphs, is enough to clear that bar.

$ go test ./internal/reader/...

The fixture intentionally contains no copyrighted content from any third party; every sentence above was written specifically for this repository.
